articles.title: Anthropic Becomes World’s 7th Most Valuable Company After IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster IPO lifted the company into the ranks of the most valuable in the world, with shares closing 17% from the offer price to give it a $1.8 trillion fully diluted market value.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO’s Australia Tranche Said About 10 Times Subscribed

articles.title: Dollar Heads for Fourth Week of Gains Following Anthropic IPO
articles.summary: The dollar is headed for a fourth straight weekly gain as demand tied to the Anthropic PBC IPO further lifts the currency that has been supported by expectations of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes and elevated US Treasury yields.

articles.title: Asian Chip Stocks Slide as Anthropic IPO Fails to Dispel AI Woes
